models.X1: Stacked J1 + M, same frozen weights (availability-informed; live headline)
models.X: Stacked: per-market linear pool of J0 and M (weights fixed on validation)
models.J0: Joint simulation, participation from history only (cutoff-faithful)
models.A: Baseline A: recency-weighted game log (NB / normal)
models.M: Gradient boosting mean + NB / normal distribution (ML challenger)

status_note: Model v0.4.1: v0.4 with a fix so that a quarterback listed Out or Doubtful cannot enter a simulated game as the replacement or for a cameo (he previously could, giving an Out QB a non-zero chance of playing). Stacking weights frozen on 2022-2023 validation. Probabilities are conditional on the player taking part (most bookmakers void a player prop if he does not play). No bookmaker prices were available to this edition, so no value claims are made.
notes: Fifth edition for Week 7: model v0.4.1 (D-016) fixes quarterbacks listed Out or Doubtful entering simulated games (in the 07:43 edition Lamar Jackson, listed Out, showed P(plays) about 16%). Inputs as the 07:43 edition (nflverse retrieved 07:42 UTC; re-checked before publishing).
Per D-008 the last edition before kickoff counts for each model; earlier Week 7 editions stay on file. Game-day inactives remain unavailable (D-009).
